tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: The use-case hubs of agentcv.ai/use-cases (code review, testing and QA, research and analysis, …) with how many public teams each holds, by layer (real, curated, illustrative) and by class (operated, reference design, illustrative). Read-only.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: The platform hubs of agentcv.ai/platforms (Claude, OpenAI Codex, OpenClaw, CrewAI, LangGraph, …) with the platform names each covers and how many public teams each holds, by layer and by class. AgentCV is independent and not affiliated with any platform. Read-only.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "validate_team_profile" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_teams, list_use_cases, validate_team_profile · Private data: validate_team_profile · Public sink: get_registration_schema, validate_team_profile · Destructive: search_teams, get_registration_schema.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_teams, list_use_cases, validate_team_profile · Private data: validate_team_profile · Public sink: get_registration_schema, validate_team_profile · Destructive: search_teams, get_registration_schema

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
